reason: The frozen semantic hasher excluded aggregate runtime and QA retrieval/answer durations but still included session-level storage_seconds. This contradicted the prefreeze statement that runtime durations were excluded and would misclassify identical semantic outputs as stochastic.
evidence_disposition: Preserve the complete root for diagnosis. The accepted MMFU unit and all partial SimpleMem artifacts are prohibited from the recovery decision and from paper-facing results.
recovery_rule: Use a fresh gate ID and root; change only the semantic hasher to exclude storage_seconds consistently with the original prefreeze.
